name: AgentTrust Referee
description: A trustless AI verdict engine. Pay 0.1 XRP, POST a task spec and proof of work, receive a structured PASS/FAIL verdict. Optional: use the full XRPL escrow protocol to lock funds and release them automatically on approval. No humans, no disputes.

authentication.description: Send 0.1 XRP to rmcSrkpZ2i2kuvtCPeTVetee9SixP4djR on XRPL Mainnet. Include the transaction hash as the x-payment-hash header or fee_hash body field.

skills.name: AI Verdict
skills.description: Stateless task verification. POST task + work + fee hash to /audit. Returns PASS/FAIL with score, summary, and criteria breakdown. No escrow required.

skills.name: Create Escrow Vault
skills.description: Lock XRPL funds in a crypto-condition escrow vault gated by AI verdict. Returns a condition for use in EscrowCreate. For the full trustless payment flow.

skills.name: Submit Work for Escrow Audit
skills.description: Worker submits proof of work against an existing vault. On PASS, returns the fulfillment key needed to complete EscrowFinish and claim payment.
